Platform Overview

“Satori was rather easy to implement and their support and guidance during the process were outstanding. We immediately get out-of-the-box features like a catalog, tags of various kinds (ex: PII, Financials, PHI) and our data is protected in real-time. Satori was easy to integrate with both oour Snowflake Data Warehouse and Looker which is our BI tool.”

“Satori is a great platform to manage essential security aspects in terms of databases – access control, full audit for queries, auto fields classification, and dynamic masking.”
“Security and compliance is super easy using Satori.”

“Satori is the most effective tool for data monitoring and security. Satori analyzes sensitive data in the organization and categorizes it across all platforms such as data storage, cloud computing, and databases. It automatically detects sensitive information and checks for duplicates, as well as providing information on who can view it, making it unique and saving a significant amount of time in structuring it.”

With Satoriʼs Data Security Platform we enable access to sensitive data in a secure, controlled and audited way, thus ensuring we meet all our compliance and security requirements.
Jack Leidecker

CISO

“The platform helps us to solve many compliance challenges and is an important part of our GDPR, HIPAA, and ISO compliance plans. On top of it, Satori’s support and customer service are some of the best I have seen.”

“Satoriʼs service is a real game changer, providing both control and visibility over data compliance and security issues across multiple data stores. We were able to deploy Satori quickly because it does not require making any changes in existing data flows.ˮ
Arun K. Buduri

VP Engineering & IT and CISO, Innovaccer

“A very dedicated and technical team. Quick to respond to everything we need – from day-to-day support up to developing new features to our unique use case.”

“Using Satori enables us to move much faster with AI & analytics. Governing GraphQL data access from the same platform that governs the rest of our data use helps us win faster with our data.”

Matthew Deadman

Software Engineering Manager, Data Platform

“The implementation was followed by technical sessions with their professional engineers, always willing to run over complicated issues and work with you together to resolve. Satori team were knowledgable, flexible and easy to work with.”

“Using Satori with Snowflake has completely transformed our approach to analytics. Seamless integration leaves us concentrating on variable insight generation rather than backend configurations.”

“With Satori we can protect our data, and have tight control over what every person in the company is allowed to see when accessing Snowflake and/or Looker. Policies can be very granular and targeted which makes the system very flexible. Compliance and auditing become less of a chore as Satori maintains logs of all data access and can also export those logs back to us via a Snowflake share, enabling reporting outside their console.”

“With Satori, the secure way is the fastest way of accessing data and getting things done. Satori allowed us to implement the need-to-know access to protect sensitive customer PII and financial data without slowing down the pace of innovation and growth. We implemented Satori in days and required no changes to our data warehouse or BI solution.”
Diedrik van Liere

CTO, Wealthsimple
